newsitem.title: UK: Gazprom says ADS priced at $15.75.
newsitem.headline: Gazprom says ADS priced at $15.75.

text.p: Russian energy giant RAO Gazprom's American Depositary Share (ADS) offering was priced at $15.75 per ADS, Gazprom said in a statement. "We are delighted by the strong interest in the global offering and in the significant level of oversubscription," said Rem Vyakhirev, chairman of Gazprom's management committee.
The issue will raise $373.275 million before expenses, or $429.267 million if an overallotment option of 15 percent of the global offering is exercised.
Under the terms of the offer, the 23.7 million ADS issued can be increased to 27.255 million.
Each ADS represents ten underlying shares and the equivalent price per share was $1.575, compared with a close of 48 cents for the underlying stock in Moscow.
Settlement for the issue will be on October 28.
The ADS will be listed on the London Stock Exchange and will start trading on October 28.
Prior to the ADS offering, 0.83 percent of Gazprom was in foreign hands, that will now rise to 1.83 percent, or 1.98 percent if the overallotment is exercised.
The company, which is the world's largest natural gas supplier, aims to sell up to nine percent of its equity on world markets once it has completed its accounts to U.S. standards.
"The global offering is an important step in Gazprom's establishment in the capital markets as the leading pan-European energy company," Vyakhirev said.

Morgan Stanley and Dresdner Kleinwort Benson are joint global coordinators for the offer, CS First Boston and ING Barings are co-lead managers and NatWest Securities and Salomon Bros are co-managers. -- David Chance London newsroom 44 171 542 5887
